findings.issue: Input::tags checked only (flags & 0x20000000 != 0) on the APEv2 footer, allowing footers with no_footer (bit 30, 0x40000000) set, and when an APEv2 header was present (flags & 0x80000000 != 0), did not verify that the header flags word at offset 20 equaled (flags | 0x20000000).

Block::parse used while at + 2 <= length and broke out of the loop when a long metadata subblock header (id & IDF_LONG != 0) had at + 4 > length, silently ignoring 1, 2, or 3 trailing bytes inside a WavPack block instead of rejecting the truncated metadata item header.

Mp3AudioReader::present_decoded returned Ok(Some(packet)) immediately when self.presentation_floor.is_none() && self.mp3.gapless.is_none(), bypassing negative source_pts rejection, channel-frame stride alignment checks, and packet.pts/timebase stamping.
Ac3AudioReader::open_mode relied solely on Ac3::parse_mode for file_bytes enforcement; adding an explicit bytes.len() > limits.file_bytes check in open_mode rejects oversized streams before parsing.
